providers.localAiDesc: Run locally on your PC without external network dependency.
providers.geminiDesc: Fast and accurate with free key from Google AI Studio.
providers.groqDesc: Llama 3.3 70B & DeepSeek R1 running on ultra-fast hardware.
providers.openrouterDesc: Multi-model gateway or custom base URL.
providers.customModelTagHelp: Specify the exact model tag (e.g., qwen2.5:14b, deepseek-r1:14b). Run 'ollama list' to view installed models.
providers.keyStoredSecurely: Key stored securely in your browser's private local storage.
providers.getKeyGemini: Get Free Key at Google AI Studio
providers.getKeyGroq: Get Free Key at Groq Console
providers.temperatureHelp: Recommended: 0.10 – 0.20 for strict factual accuracy (Zero Hallucinations).
providers.byoAiDesc: Copy calibrated prompts to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Web, or DeepSeek and paste the response back.
providers.byoAiStep1: 1. CV Studio formats your master data, target vacancy, and ATS rules into a single calibrated prompt.
providers.byoAiStep2: 2. Click Copy and paste into your favorite web AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Web, DeepSeek, Perplexity).
providers.byoAiStep3: 3. Paste the AI response back into CV Studio. Formatting, scoring, and previewing work seamlessly!
providers.pasteAiResponsePlaceholder: Paste the complete response generated by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini here...
providers.invalidResponse: Please paste the AI response before continuing.
